title: confiture migrate schema-to-schema cleanup --format json
description: Result of removing the foreign server and the foreign schema from the target after cutover; the migrated rows stay. The payload is the envelope alone. The CLI assembles it. A failure writes the error envelope (error-envelope.schema.json) instead of this shape.

ok.description: The envelope (1.16.0): the command produced this report. A command that could not produce one writes the error envelope, where ok is false.

command.description: The envelope (1.16.0): the command that wrote this payload, as typed after `confiture`.
